name: abyme-stack-firebase
description: The Island / ABYME — the shared stack (STACK.md slice 8). Rules are the server.

scripts.//test: The Firestore emulator is a Java program. macOS's /usr/bin/java is a stub, and Homebrew keeps openjdk keg-only (off PATH, to avoid clashing with Apple's). So we point at the existing install here rather than making anyone think about it. A missing dir on PATH is ignored, so this is harmless on machines that don't need it.
